candidates.change_summary: Change the required caller address to the contract's caddress instead of from, altering who is authorized to call transfer.
Change the require that _tos has items to require it be empty, flipping the loop execution for callers who pass non-empty arrays.
Replace the call target so that the contract calls from (the original sender address) instead of caddress, changing which address receives the external call.
Multiply the value by 1 instead of 10^18, changing the amount passed to transferFrom.
Use delegatecall instead of call when invoking transferFrom on caddress, changing context of the external call and its return handling.
